review.why: Plans SMS, MMS and WhatsApp marketing: when texting beats email, consent and carrier rules, number types, sequences, copy limits and metrics.
review.summary: Opens with compliance: US consent, quiet hours, STOP and HELP, carrier registration, plus EU, UK and Canada notes. It compares SMS with email, covers WhatsApp windows and templates, number types, per-send cost, message length and segments, sequences such as abandoned cart and win-back, platform picks and metrics, and ends with a compliance footer.
strengths: Compliance comes first and blockers are flagged before strategy
Practical copy limits: segments, encoding and cost per message
Clear use-case table for when SMS or email fits better
cautions: Law and carrier rules vary by country and change: legal review needed
Cost, pricing and benchmark figures date quickly
Four reference files are not read here
